I strongly see there is a need to test at the 1.196 where price broke out from the support. and there is a gap there.A 2nd gap from the top. The final gap will appear below 1.040 before it will finally reverse back to close the 1st gap as Target 1 at 1.3237. At 1.196 the sell target is parity 1.000 or lower. (0.9800)

I will try to be more active in trading intraday setups. Till Then. Happy Profiting
